# Amber residue source controls

These files preserve the original RuBP and KCX residue templates and the
CO2/O2 PREP and FRCMOD gas stock.
They support chemical correspondence and exact parameter-transformation tests,
not force-field accuracy claims.
Use the adjacent MIT license for their original attribution.

The source is `kacarlab/RuBisCO_evolution`, commit
`e6c621656ca1a8eb7e09381d6405da5d412274a1`.
The templates and parameter files came from `data/systems_for_MD/parameters/`.
The source license came from the repository root.
The test binds each file's exact SHA-256 digest.
